identity.name: EcoTrade Global
identity.description: A high-end B2B marketplace for the paper scrap industry. Design should feel like a modern logistics manifest—clean, data-dense, yet organic.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and big stats. Tight tracking.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, data tables, inputs, and UI elements. optimize for legibility.

mono.usage: Use for Order IDs, SKU numbers, Price tickers, and Technical specs.

primary.name: Industrial Forest
primary.usage: Primary brand color. Use for active states, primary buttons, and logo.

secondary.name: Container Blue
secondary.usage: Secondary brand color. Use for headers, footers, and shipper profiles.

accent.name: Safety Orange
accent.usage: High-visibility CTAs, alerts, notifications, and 'New' badges.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise texture to the background (#F4F4F0) to give it a 'recycled paper' feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use minimal, sharp shadows. No diffuse glows. Think 'printed material'.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders. Avoid rounded corners > 4px. Aim for a 'machined' look.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to index.html immediately.
RESET CSS: Ensure 'Barlow Condensed' is used for all headings (h1-h6) and 'Inter' for body.
TEXTURE: Add a subtle noise background image or CSS pattern to the body to kill the 'flat digital' look.
COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove rounded-lg, change to rounded-sm. Remove soft shadows, use 1px borders.
HERO SECTION: Use the 'hero_background' image with a dark overlay (#1B365D at 80% opacity) and white text.
CARDS: Do not use default Shadcn cards. Create a custom 'IndustrialCard' with a thick top border in the primary color.
TABLES: Use high-density tables for the dashboard. Reduce padding. Use zebra striping (odd: bg-white, even: bg-[#F9F9F9]).
CTA: Primary buttons must be big, bold, and rectangular. No soft gradients.
FORMS: Inputs should feel like physical paper forms - sharp edges, clear labels.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
